description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
